claim: External prediction-model guidance and risk-of-bias tools emphasize prespecified evaluation, validation, applicability, and overfitting risk when developing or validating clinical prediction models.
future_grounding_route: Use only as methodological context for validation discipline; any biomarker claim still requires project-grounded cross-validation, null testing, and external cohort validation.
project_use: External method context for V49 convergence review of the project's small-n prediction-model discipline; not evidence that the V22 scalar works.
relationship_note: The source aligns with the project's refusal to promote in-sample or flexible-model improvements without small-n-aware validation, but it does not validate any MS-specific scalar.

source.citation: Wolff et al. PROBAST: A Tool to Assess the Risk of Bias and Applicability of Prediction Model Studies. Annals of Internal Medicine. 2019.
source.label: PROBAST prediction-model risk-of-bias guidance

why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun consensus-methodology guidance from held MS data.
